title: matrix copy: write exactly the preview the owner confirmed and check add ids across dry runs

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-021106-86c7 for S261 (discovered from S261):

Bind the CLI write to the preview the owner confirmed
The CLI previews in one call and writes in a second (`internal/cli/roles.go:126-196`). The second call runs a fresh dry run, so what gets written can differ from what the owner said yes to. The spec asked for this two-call shape (Implement step 7).
Importance: 2
Urgency: 1
Effort: 2

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions (2026-11-25): How does the confirmed write get bound to the previewed result? -> expect-steps: add the per-project step list from the preview to `MatrixCopyParams`. The daemon re-runs its dry run and refuses that project with a stale-preview error if the steps differ. It writes nothing for a refused project and goes on to the others, as `matrixCopy` does now. [matrix.copy-bind-preview].
